entities.summary: Artyomovsky is a town in Sverdlovsk Oblast, Russia, located on the Bobrovka River, 120 kilometers (75 mi) northeast of Yekaterinburg. Population: 33,160 (2010 census); 34,980 (2002 census); 41,247 (1989 Soviet census).
